source: M11 gap attribution — evidence: static audit 2026-09-26 + 20 reference verdicts + pilot 4 pairs/8 arms + gates/G5

summary.engineCeiling: 10/10 scenes FEASIBLE on AIR (79/79 probes, fps 60.0-60.3, 0 console errors). Only two hard engine ceilings found: no usable postprocess pipeline (Code First) and KHR transmission built-in path is dead code. Everything else is reachable but with heavy engineering paths and silent-failure traps.
summary.agentAttainment: Pilot K0: AIR 2/4 PASS (E01 win +0.08, E10 tie +0.01, E02 loss -0.25, E05 both-engine fail -0.02). Agent gap is real but narrow; the dominant signal is cost, not feasibility.

biggestChangeVsStaticAudit: Static audit said 'shadow delivery incomplete, lighting unclear' — experiment proves dynamic point-light pipeline FULL (per-frame UBO animation, E06) while point-light SHADOW is the actual hard gap.

Static audit listed transmission as 'partial (WebGL2, needs explicit mount)' — experiment proves the built-in KHR transmission path is dead code since first commit; only custom EffectAsset route works.

Static audit treated docs/examples as adequate baseline — experiment shows 8/8 K0 arms hit engine behavioral traps (silent NaN, event swallowing, reflection-style effect JSON); .d.ts advantage did not convert to lower cost.

engineBugs.title: air-gltf-standard renders textured GLB pure black (K0 tarball)
engineBugs.repro: vendor/cocosair.js-1.0.0-k0.tgz + assets/character.glb (Khronos Fox): glTF material path -> black silhouette; builtin-standard + USE_DIFFUSEMAP -> correct; Reference workspace same asset renders correctly (suspected tarball/build-path defect)
engineBugs.impact: 3 diagnosis rounds + full material replacement in pilot E10 arm-a; if general, all textured-GLB scenes untrustworthy on K0 deliverable

engineBugs.title: KHR transmission built-in path is dead code
engineBugs.repro: src/air/assets/gltf/material/physical-effect.ts L170/L348: airTrFactorTex/airThickTex declared but never assigned from uniforms -> trF constant 0 -> transmission/volume/dispersion GLB renders opaque PBR; identical in repo and tarball; missing since first commit 09b624c
engineBugs.impact: 'Official transmission support' claim does not match rendering; any agent taking the glTF-extension route fails

engineBugs.title: Material.setProperty FLOAT4 accepts plain array -> silent NaN black screen
engineBugs.repro: setProperty(name, [x,y,z,w]) on FLOAT4 -> setUniformArray per-element write, FLOAT4 writer reads .x -> undefined -> NaN; shader compiles, 0 console errors, screen black
engineBugs.impact: Highest-frequency K0 black-screen root cause (E02-a 4 builds; E01-b 6 rounds)

engineBugs.title: Light.color fed Vec3 -> NaN white screen
engineBugs.repro: light.color = vec3-like object; setter reads .r/.g/.b without type check; NaN spreads to all lit pixels
engineBugs.impact: One misuse kills the whole screen; same NaN family as EB-03

engineBugs.title: Runtime Material.setProperty(Vec4) loses .w
engineBugs.repro: Initial upload OK; after update shader reads 0 in .w; staged pass.getUniform reads back correct; suspected staged->GPU upload path
engineBugs.impact: All runtime material animation depending on .w breaks; workaround = pre-multiply in JS, use xyz only

engineBugs.title: getLocation(out) with plain object poisons event dispatcher
engineBugs.repro: out not a real Vec2 -> 'out.set is not a function' -> input._emitEvent catch -> _clearEvents + onThrowException + rethrow -> whole-page input permanently dead
engineBugs.impact: One throwing callback kills the input system; symptom far from root cause

engineBugs.title: POINT_LIST double patch: createMesh falsy-zero + pass-level primitive
engineBugs.repro: utils.createMesh({primitiveMode: gfx.PrimitiveMode.POINT_LIST}) -> struct primitiveMode === 7 (TRIANGLE_LIST); after fixing mesh.struct, still draws triangles until effect JSON pass adds "primitive": 0 (Pass._primitive, pipeline-state-manager.ts:55)
engineBugs.impact: Point-cloud intent silently renders garbage triangles (additive -> full-screen overexposure); E01 reference first-run P2 symptom

engineBugs.title: Canvas/pal layer swallows wheel and DOM mouse events
engineBugs.repro: window bubble wheel listener never fires (canvas target-phase preventDefault+stopPropagation); pal layer stopPropagation on canvas mousemove
engineBugs.impact: Scroll/drag interactions dead; misattributed to 'wrong event vocabulary'; E01-b cost 3 rounds

engineBugs.title: Vertex-stage UBO read drift (root cause not located)
engineBugs.repro: Vertex shader v_dbg = vec2(pxScale/1000, cc_screenSize.y/1000) imaging: different stars show 27-232 discrete value clusters (constant uniform should be uniform); CCCamera/CCLocal vertex stage normal
engineBugs.impact: Vertex-stage uniforms unreliable; forces architecture change (bake to attributes, rebuild on resize); adds agent trial rounds but does not cap capability

engineBugs.title: No usable postprocess in Code First pipeline
engineBugs.repro: Three gates: aggregate entry does not import postprocess, cclegacy.rendering cleared, CUSTOM_PIPELINE_NAME unset -> no Bloom/Tonemap/FXAA; engine bundle postprocess code round-trips but never applies
engineBugs.impact: FX quality dimension capped in 7/10 scenes (E05 2/3, E10 1.5/3, E04 -0.5 x2); substitute reaches 80-85% of bloom in close-up compositions only

engineBugs.title: Point light shadow unsupported; ShadowMap blackens materials in K0 build
engineBugs.repro: src/cocos/render-scene/scene/point-light.ts class comment 'It doesn't support shadow generation currently.'; pilot E10 arm-a: enabling ShadowMap blackened fox materials, fell back to ShadowType.Planar
engineBugs.impact: Dynamic point-light scenes lose shadow layering (blob-shadow workaround); ShadowMap quality/blackening needs investigation

engineBugs.title: Fog toggle recompiles all material variants (~100ms jank)
engineBugs.repro: scene.globals.fog runtime toggle is a pipeline-macro switch -> all variants recompile, single-frame ~100ms hitch; unlit fog factor is per-vertex (interpolation error on huge triangles)
engineBugs.impact: 'Immediate toggle' contracts either hitch or need pre-run configuration

engineBugs.title: camera.visibility default undefined -> silent black screen
engineBugs.repro: Do not set camera.visibility -> nothing renders, zero errors
engineBugs.impact: Shortest path to 'all black but no error'; high-frequency agent trap

engineBugs.title: EffectAsset registration timing constraint errors silently
engineBugs.repro: EffectAsset.onLoaded() before createAirApp() -> registration silently ineffective (internal deps missing)
engineBugs.impact: Custom shader does nothing with zero error output

engineBugs.title: No sRGB texture format; procedural textures darken
engineBugs.repro: Texture2D.reset()+uploadData(canvas): linear-domain darkening; non-POT only CLAMP_TO_EDGE; no y-flip; display value = stored value squared (no output gamma)
engineBugs.impact: Hidden root cause of 'cannot match reference look'; ground base color needed ~#98 for mid-grey

engineBugs.title: AnimationClip.wrapMode defaults non-Loop; clip-level props shared across instances
engineBugs.repro: GLB clip plays once then freezes at last frame (no crash, motion assertions silently fail); wrapMode/duration shared per sceneIndex via sceneClips cache; per-instance variants need manual clip copy
engineBugs.impact: Pilot E10 arm-a first verify 15/19; isolation boundary at clip-data layer unclear

engineBugs.title: No in-place vertex buffer write API
engineBugs.repro: docs/manual/custom-buffergeometry.md §2; CPU vertex animation must rebuild whole mesh (per-frame infeasible) -> shader displacement or dynamic mesh only
engineBugs.impact: Largest channel difference vs three BufferAttribute.needsUpdate; all vertex animation pushed to shader/dynamic-mesh paths

engineBugs.title: No InstancedMesh/Points/3D-particle first-class API
engineBugs.repro: 500+ instances: merged static mesh (static) or CPU dynamic mesh (dynamic); no GPU lifecycle/emitter semantics; no point sprites (4 verts + 6 indices per particle, 4x bandwidth)
engineBugs.impact: Scale ceiling is fine (E07: 1,536 buildings/70k rain @54.7fps; E01: 74.5k points 60fps) but per-instance animation = CPU vertex rewrite, no GPU culling; usability/documentation gap more than capability gap

engineBugs.title: API consistency long tail (12 items)
engineBugs.repro: quad ignores size (±0.5 hardcoded); plane is XZ; no Quaternion export; clearColor/light.color assign-not-mutate; getScrollY=-deltaY*5; screenPointToRay param order differs component vs render-scene; getComponent(string) fails; Node.addChild returns void; fog.enabled before fog.type; missing minPos/maxPos silently culls; createDynamicMesh location differs repo vs tarball; dual-side needs USE_TWOSIDE + cullMode
engineBugs.impact: Each small, together the main K0 trial-and-error tax (E06 reference itself crashed 2 rounds on Quat)

knowledgeBackfill.items: Event-layer contract (canvas wheel stopPropagation, pal mousemove swallow); capture-phase + input.on(TOUCH_*) dual canonical channels; mouse/touch double-fire dedup; getLocation needs real Vec2 + try/catch; getScrollY=-deltaY*5
setProperty type contract (FLOAT4 must be Vec4/Color; arrays -> NaN); runtime Vec4 use xyz only; direction attributes must not set linear:true; NaN symptom->root-cause quick table (black/white/drift)

Compiled-form effect JSON template + generator; glsl4/glsl3 variants (glsl1 unused on WebGL2); register after createAirApp; defines frozen at init; blendState+priority ordering; pass primitive field; mediump->highp

Batching three-route decision tree + scale budget table (merged static mesh / dynamic mesh <=50k quads@60fps conservative, 100k anchor); createMesh primitiveMode patch; primitives size semantics (quad 1x1, plane XZ); minPos/maxPos mandatory; createDynamicMesh non-empty init + capacity asserts + tarball path
HDR unit conversion table; night baseline values (ambient ~3800 + moon ~1900 lux); assign-not-mutate semantics; camera.visibility; brightness=stored^2 compensation; no-sRGB procedural texture recipe

GLTFAsset addRef pinning across resets; wrapMode=Loop before first instantiate; clip-level sharing boundary; dispose/destroy pairing list; K0-tarball air-gltf-standard black-render workaround (builtin-standard + USE_DIFFUSEMAP)
Bloom-impostor recipe (multi-layer additive billboards + in-shader falloff + dither); blob shadow; contact-shadow baking — each Reference (E01/E04/E05/E06/E07/E10) is a directly reusable example
OrbitControls-equivalent recipe (spherical + exponential smoothing, consolidated from E03/E05/E06) + assertion-friendly smoothing guidance (keep post-action residual motion within sample windows)

Probe/assertion semantics for this benchmark: state assertions sampled after action within sampleWindowMs; nonBlank per-region litRatio thresholds; regionChange needs continuous motion source; visual-density budget formula (star count x diameter -> per-corner litRatio); __bench-assisted per-region readout to align self-check with harness

notes: typeCounts counts the primary type of each gap entry (multi-type gaps like NaN-family (engine+diagnostics) counted once under engine); §6 of cocosair-gap-map.md carries the full multi-type mapping.
Simulation domain has no new engine evidence in the pilot (E08 not sampled for agent runs; physics not covered by any of the 10 scenes) — static-audit conclusions stand, deferred to M7.
Visual six-dim figures quoted are reference self-scores / two-judge averages; preference verdicts are BLOCKED (G7).
